messages:
maria: quick sync: follow-up on remote pacing adapter boundary. want a tight contract we can ship this quarter.

sam: goal: small sync grant API + report call. keep decision logic in pacing service, router only enforces.

ken: agree but need batching support. router should be able to send N sub-requests and get per-id grants.

maria: yes. API: RequestGrant(requests[]) -> responses[]. responses include allowed, granted_tokens, recommended_delay_ms. ReportUsage(request_id, used).

lee: failure modes: if pacing slow/unavailable router uses local bounded burst pool and soft-sheds beyond threshold. define queue size and timeouts.

ashley: add X-Tenant-Priority and X-Abuse-Score headers so adapter can account for probation and priority. also propagate trace-id.

sam: telemetry: emit grant_latency, grants_by_tenant, fallback_rate. traces should join router->pacing->model.

ken: billing: pacing is authoritative for grants. router must persist usage events locally until acked by ReportUsage. no drops.

maria: security: mTLS + short-lived service tokens, RBAC to limit callers, audit for overrides. admin endpoint /v1/pacing/{tenant}:override for temporary boosts.

lee: rollout: feature-flag adapter, deploy pacing in passive mode (recommendations only), collect signals, then enable soft then hard enforcement per-tenant.

ashley: ops: add alerts for fallback_rate > 0.05% and reconciliation drift > 500 tokens over 5min.

ken: tests: unit adapter, e2e chaos with delayed pacing, load calibration for burst sizing.

ops-bot: deploybot: pacing-service canary deployed eu-central-1 rev r2026-11, health: passing :white_check_mark:

maria: thanks everyone, i'll open follow-up PRs for proto and runbook and tag reviewers.

sam: will prototype adapter this week.

ken: proto draft incoming.

lee: working on runbook.

ashley: prepping dashboards.
